notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B) building a product search + support assistant. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick integration, then Dedicated reserved capacity for production. Team: product + infra + security. POC goals: reliable semantic recall for top-K, low tail latency, and cost predictability for nightly embedding refreshes.

Key technical requirements (from calls):
- Workload: embeddings for ~200k docs initially; nightly batch embed job (~200k vectors), incremental updates during day. Real-time semantic search QPS target: 300-600 qps (peak), average ~120 qps. Retrieval latency SLO: 50-150ms (index + embed lookup + rerank).
- Throughput: need sustained vectorization throughput for nightly jobs (200k docs in <6 hours preferred).
- Vector DB integration: currently prototyping with Pinecone and pgvector (Postgres). Want Redwood to integrate cleanly w/ existing pipeline (batch embed API, bulk upload hooks), and support direct routing from hosted API to their vector DB or Redwood-managed index.
- Model preferences: open / quantized embedding model (cost sensitive). Interested in Redwood's curated embedding models + ability to pin model versions. Want fallback plan if higher-cost models needed for quality.
- Routing/fallback: prefer Hosted API for pilot; Dedicated once latency/cost baseline validated. Want autoscaling, can accept burst billing.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 expected, SSO (SAML) for Console, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal asks for DPA and breach notification timelines.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market constraints; looking for committed ARR discount in exchange for monthly commit. Asked for cost per 1M tokens and per 100k embeddings for both Hosted and Dedicated.

Direct quotes / call snippets: "We need the nightly embed job to finish by morning — otherwise the product search degrades for users." — Product Lead.

POC notes / action items:
- AE (Avery): finalize Dedicated sizing questionnaire and collect peak QPS traces (due 2026-03-12).
- SE (Jordan): provide integration guide for pgvector + Pinecone (stubs + sample code) and run a short benchmark with Redwood Hosted embeddings (due 2026-03-14).
- Security: provide SOC2 report + KMS integration docs; attach to Drive security FAQ.
- Finance: provide committed vs burst pricing scenarios; include estimated ARR ranges and margin analysis for the customer's usage pattern.

Current sentiment: cautiously optimistic. Product team likes quality of embeddings; infra and security need more detail on residency and certs. Budget aligned to April cycle.
